```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script generates iTOL (Interactive Tree of Life) annotation files for the
Ostreobium phylogenetic tree built in `ostreobium_tree.Rmd`.
Upload the output files to iTOL to overlay them on the tree.

```{r load-data}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../../microbiome/data/ps_final.rds")
```

```{r itol-ostreobium}
# =============================================================================
# iTOL datasets — Ostreobium ASVs: simplebars + heatmaps
# Author: Joana Krause
# Description:
#   1) Writes three iTOL SIMPLEBAR tracks per ASV (across all samples):
#        A. Total reads (raw counts)
#        B. Prevalence (% of samples where ASV is present)
#        C. Mean relative abundance (%) within Ostreobium
#
#   2) Writes two iTOL DATASET_HEATMAP files:
#        - By geographic location (blue scale)
#        - By coral type: complexa / robusta / octocoral (brown scale)
#
#   Zero-masking: ASVs absent from a group (mean = 0) are set to NA and
#   rendered white in iTOL (COLOR_NA = #ffffff). Non-zero values are
#   log10-transformed after conversion to %.
#
#   Mean relative abundance is computed across ALL samples in a group,
#   including samples where the ASV is absent (abundance = 0). This is a
#   prevalence-weighted mean: it reflects both how abundant an ASV is when
#   present and how frequently it occurs across samples.
#
#   Color scales:
#   - By location:   sequential blue  (#f7fbff -> #9ecae1 -> #08306b)
#   - By coral type: sequential brown (#f7fbff -> #c19d76 -> #3b2305)
#
#   Color scale limits:
#   - vmin = observed global minimum across both heatmaps (data-driven)
#   - vmax = observed global maximum across both heatmaps (data-driven)
#   Both heatmaps share the same scale, making them directly comparable.
#   The faintest color always corresponds to the rarest real detection.
#   White = true absence (ASV not detected in any sample of that group).
# =============================================================================

# -- 0) Libraries --------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})

# -- 1) Parameters — edit here -------------------------------------------------
ps_input <- ps_plas_V3_V4   # full phyloseq object
out_dir  <- "../itol"       # phylogenies/itol/

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

locations_order <- c(
  "Central Pacific",
  "North East Pacific",
  "North West Atlantic",
  "Mediterranean Sea",
  "Red Sea",
  "Indian Ocean",
  "North West Pacific",
  "South West Pacific"
)

coral_order <- c("complexa", "robusta", "octocoral")

# -- 2) Subset and normalize ---------------------------------------------------
ps_sub <- ps_input %>%
  subset_taxa(Genus == "Ostreobium") %>%
  subset_samples(coral_health == "healthy" & complexa_robusta != "black coral") %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .)

# Relative abundance within Ostreobium, per sample
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_sub, function(x) {
  s <- sum(x)
  if (s == 0) rep(0, length(x)) else x / s
})

# -- 3) OTU table -> long format -----------------------------------------------
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

otu_long <- as.data.frame(otu_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -SampleID, names_to = "ASV", values_to = "RelAbund") %>%
  mutate(RelAbund = as.numeric(RelAbund))

sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rel)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

# -- 4) Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------

# log10-transform with zero masking:
# True zeros (absent ASVs) become NA -> rendered white in iTOL via COLOR_NA.
# Non-zero values are log10-transformed.
log10_zeromask <- function(mat) {
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(mat), ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  nonzero <- mat != 0
  out[nonzero] <- log10(mat[nonzero])
  out
}

# Write iTOL SIMPLEBAR file
write_itol_simplebar <- function(vec, outfile, dataset_label,
                                 color = "#4B9CD3", width = 60, margin = 6,
                                 height_factor = 1) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(vec), !is.null(names(vec)))
  con <- file(outfile, open = "wt")
  on.exit(close(con))
  writeLines(c(
    "DATASET_SIMPLEBAR",
    "SEPARATOR\tTAB",
    paste0("DATASET_LABEL\t", dataset_label),
    paste0("COLOR\t",         color),
    paste0("WIDTH\t",         width),
    paste0("MARGIN\t",        margin),
    paste0("HEIGHT_FACTOR\t", height_factor),
    "DATA"
  ), con)
  out <- data.frame(leaf = names(vec), value = as.numeric(vec))
  out <- out[order(out$leaf), ]
  write.table(out, con, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  message("Written: ", outfile)
}

# Write iTOL DATASET_HEATMAP file
write_itol_heatmap <- function(heat_wide, field_cols, vmin, vmax,
                               dataset_label, legend_title,
                               color_min, color_mid, color_max,
                               outfile) {
  con <- file(outfile, "wt")
  on.exit(close(con))
  writeLines(c(
    "DATASET_HEATMAP",
    "SEPARATOR\tTAB",
    paste0("DATASET_LABEL\t", dataset_label),
    paste0("LEGEND_TITLE\t",  legend_title),
    paste0("FIELD_LABELS\t",  paste(field_cols, collapse = "\t")),
    paste0("FIELD_COLORS\t",  paste(rep("#c6dbef", length(field_cols)), collapse = "\t")),
    paste0("COLOR_MIN\t", color_min),
    paste0("COLOR_MID\t", color_mid),
    paste0("COLOR_MAX\t", color_max),
    "USE_MID_COLOR\t1",
    "COLOR_NA\t#ffffff",
    sprintf("USER_MIN_VALUE\t%.4f", vmin),
    sprintf("USER_MAX_VALUE\t%.4f", vmax),
    "DATA"
  ), con)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(heat_wide))) {
    vals <- as.numeric(heat_wide[i, field_cols])
    writeLines(
      paste(c(heat_wide$ASV[i], sprintf("%.6f", vals)), collapse = "\t"),
      con
    )
  }
  message("Written: ", outfile)
}

# =============================================================================
# PART 1 — Simplebar tracks (all samples pooled, no group breakdown)
# =============================================================================

# Raw count matrix (taxa as rows) for simplebar metrics
otu_counts <- as(otu_table(ps_sub), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_sub)) otu_counts <- t(otu_counts)

# (A) Total reads per ASV
total_reads <- rowSums(otu_counts)

# (B) Prevalence: % of samples where ASV is present
prevalence_pct <- (rowSums(otu_counts > 0) / ncol(otu_counts)) * 100

# (C) Mean relative abundance (%) within Ostreobium across all samples
#     Normalized per sample, then averaged (including zeros for absent ASVs)
otu_rel_pct <- apply(otu_counts, 2, function(x) {
  s <- sum(x)
  if (s == 0) rep(0, length(x)) else (x / s) * 100
})
mean_rel_abundance_pct <- rowMeans(otu_rel_pct)

# Write simplebar files
write_itol_simplebar(
  vec           = total_reads,
  outfile       = file.path(out_dir, "itol_simplebar_ostreobium_total_reads.txt"),
  dataset_label = "Ostreobium total reads",
  color         = "#2C7FB8"   # blue
)

write_itol_simplebar(
  vec           = prevalence_pct,
  outfile       = file.path(out_dir, "itol_simplebar_ostreobium_prevalence_pct.txt"),
  dataset_label = "Ostreobium prevalence (% of samples)",
  color         = "#1A9850"   # green
)

write_itol_simplebar(
  vec           = mean_rel_abundance_pct,
  outfile       = file.path(out_dir, "itol_simplebar_ostreobium_mean_rel_abundance_pct.txt"),
  dataset_label = "Ostreobium mean relative abundance (%)",
  color         = "#D95F0E"   # orange
)

# =============================================================================
# PART 2 — Heatmaps by location and coral type
# =============================================================================

# -- Location heatmap ----------------------------------------------------------

canon_map <- c(
  "central pacific"     = "Central Pacific",
  "north east pacific"  = "North East Pacific",
  "northeast pacific"   = "North East Pacific",
  "north west atlantic" = "North West Atlantic",
  "northwest atlantic"  = "North West Atlantic",
  "mediterranean"       = "Mediterranean Sea",
  "mediterranean sea"   = "Mediterranean Sea",
  "red sea"             = "Red Sea",
  "indian ocean"        = "Indian Ocean",
  "north west pacific"  = "North West Pacific",
  "northwest pacific"   = "North West Pacific",
  "south west pacific"  = "South West Pacific",
  "southwest pacific"   = "South West Pacific"
)

otu_loc <- otu_long %>%
  left_join(sample_df[, c("SampleID", "generic_location")], by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(generic_location = generic_location %>%
           as.character() %>%
           str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
           str_squish() %>%
           str_to_lower() %>%
           recode(!!!canon_map, .default = NA_character_))

mean_loc <- otu_loc %>%
  filter(!is.na(generic_location)) %>%
  group_by(ASV, generic_location) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(RelAbund, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop")

heat_loc <- mean_loc %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = generic_location, values_from = MeanAbundance,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(ASV)

present_locs <- intersect(locations_order, colnames(heat_loc))
heat_loc <- heat_loc[, c("ASV", present_locs)]

mat_loc <- log10_zeromask(as.matrix(heat_loc[, present_locs]))
heat_loc[, present_locs] <- mat_loc

# -- Coral type heatmap --------------------------------------------------------
otu_coral <- otu_long %>%
  left_join(sample_df[, c("SampleID", "complexa_robusta")], by = "SampleID")

mean_coral <- otu_coral %>%
  filter(!is.na(complexa_robusta)) %>%
  group_by(ASV, complexa_robusta) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(RelAbund, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop")

heat_coral <- mean_coral %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = complexa_robusta, values_from = MeanAbundance,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(ASV)

present_groups <- intersect(coral_order, colnames(heat_coral))
heat_coral <- heat_coral[, c("ASV", present_groups)]

mat_coral <- log10_zeromask(as.matrix(heat_coral[, present_groups]))
heat_coral[, present_groups] <- mat_coral

# -- Shared color scale limits -------------------------------------------------
# Both vmin and vmax are data-driven: computed from the observed non-zero
# log10 values across both heatmaps. This ensures:
#   - The faintest color = rarest real detection (no wasted color space)
#   - The darkest color = most abundant real detection
#   - Both heatmaps are directly comparable
vmin_global <- min(
  min(mat_loc[is.finite(mat_loc)],     na.rm = TRUE),
  min(mat_coral[is.finite(mat_coral)], na.rm = TRUE)
)
vmax_global <- max(
  max(mat_loc[is.finite(mat_loc)],     na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mat_coral[is.finite(mat_coral)], na.rm = TRUE)
)

message(sprintf("Color scale: %.4f to %.4f (log10 %%)", vmin_global, vmax_global))
message(sprintf("  = %.4f%% to %.2f%% relative abundance",
                10^vmin_global, 10^vmax_global))

# -- Write heatmap files -------------------------------------------------------

# Location heatmap — blue scale
write_itol_heatmap(
  heat_wide     = heat_loc,
  field_cols    = present_locs,
  vmin          = vmin_global,
  vmax          = vmax_global,
  dataset_label = "Ostreobium ASVs by location (log10 %, zero-masked)",
  legend_title  = "Mean relative abundance (log10 %)",
  color_min     = "#f7fbff",
  color_mid     = "#9ecae1",
  color_max     = "#08306b",
  outfile       = file.path(out_dir, "itol_heatmap_ostreobium_location_log10_zeromasked.txt")
)

# Coral type heatmap — brown scale
write_itol_heatmap(
  heat_wide     = heat_coral,
  field_cols    = present_groups,
  vmin          = vmin_global,
  vmax          = vmax_global,
  dataset_label = "Ostreobium ASVs by coral type (log10 %, zero-masked)",
  legend_title  = "Mean relative abundance (log10 %)",
  color_min     = "#f7fbff",
  color_mid     = "#c19d76",
  color_max     = "#3b2305",
  outfile       = file.path(out_dir, "itol_heatmap_ostreobium_coraltype_log10_zeromasked.txt")
)

# -- Sanity checks -------------------------------------------------------------
message("\n-- Sanity checks --")
message("ASVs total (ps_sub):             ", ntaxa(ps_sub))
message("ASVs in simplebar tracks:        ", length(total_reads))
message("ASVs in location heatmap:        ", nrow(heat_loc))
message("ASVs in coral-type heatmap:      ", nrow(heat_coral))
message("Location columns:    ", paste(present_locs,   collapse = ", "))
message("Coral-type columns:  ", paste(present_groups, collapse = ", "))
message("Non-zero values in location heatmap:   ", sum(is.finite(mat_loc)))
message("Non-zero values in coral-type heatmap: ", sum(is.finite(mat_coral)))
```
